What OAuth providers are needed?: T3K is the only OAuth provider. No Google/GitHub/Facebook needed.
How much of the codebase already exists?: 17/20 Phase 4 files exist on disk. All routers are mounted, most services/repos/APIs are wired. This is wiring verification and bug-fixing, not net-new implementation.
What about Tag/Preset entities?: Tag and Preset entities need domain entities and repos to complete the stack. ORM models may exist but service wiring needs verification.
What about UserNotification/AuditLog?: UserNotification and AuditLog have ORM models but may need service wiring to complete the stack.
Is this a feature branch or main?: Feature branch (95/phase-4-completion-di-tracks-groups-shoo). No redis/worker/scheduler available — worker-dependent features must be deferred.
What is the validation strategy?: Primarily just check + just test-regression for quality gates. E2E tests via just test-golden-path for user-facing verification.
